functions.name: upload-nach-form
functions.description: Submit a customer's signed NACH form image for mandate registration against an existing order.

fileName.description: Image filename with a supported extension; not a local filesystem path.

mediaType.description: Image MIME type matching its bytes.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of exact signed image bytes; decoded size must not exceed 6,000,000 bytes under the conservative public size policy.

FunctionInput_razorpay_uploadnachform.description: Registration order and the exact signed NACH form image to submit.

id.description: Payment identifier for the registration submission.

signature.description: Provider verification signature; not proof of bank mandate approval.

FunctionOutput_razorpay_uploadnachform.description: Submission identifiers and verification signature, not bank-confirmed mandate registration.

tags.instructions: Have the registration order and the complete signed form image. Use JPEG or PNG, at most 6 MB, without cropped borders or changed fields. Upload returns submission identifiers, not bank-confirmed mandate registration. If a form is pending at the destination bank, wait for its decision before uploading another.

functions.name: upload-order-document
functions.description: Upload one education or travel remittance document for an existing order.

mimeType.description: Media type of the original document bytes.

documentType.description: Business category of the uploaded evidence.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of the original binary file, decoded internally for upload.

FunctionInput_razorpay_uploadorderdocume.description: One original document and its remittance order, purpose, and business category.

orderId.description: Order to which this upload was submitted.

createdAt.description: Upload creation instant in UTC at second precision.

FunctionOutput_razorpay_uploadorderdocum.description: Metadata returned for the uploaded remittance document.

tags.instructions: Use with the remittance order ID and the original document file. Choose the education/travel purpose and document category required for that flow. This uploads evidence for processing; it does not approve or settle the remittance. Use `get-order` to verify an order ID.

functions.name: upload-stakeholder-document

mimeType.description: Original media type; JPG/PNG max 4 MB, PDF max 2 MB.

documentType.description: Personal evidence category; spelling matches the provider's category codes.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of original binary evidence, decoded internally; decoded size limits also apply.

stakeholderId.description: Person receiving this personal KYC evidence.

FunctionInput_razorpay_uploadstakeholder.description: One original identity document and its parent account and stakeholder.

url.description: Provider-returned document link; omitted if absent and preserved if null.

items.description: One document reference returned by Razorpay.
References returned after submission, potentially including existing documents.
